regulations.provision: Registration is mandatory where land exceeds 500 sq m or the project has more than 8 apartments (all phases counted).

70% of amounts realised from allottees must be held in a separate scheduled-bank account and used only for land and construction of that project; withdrawals certified by an engineer, architect and CA.
No more than 10% of the cost may be taken as advance or application fee before a registered agreement for sale.
Structural defects or workmanship defects notified within 5 years of possession must be rectified within 30 days without charge.
On delayed possession, the promoter pays interest for every month of delay (rate prescribed in state rules, typically SBI MCLR + 2%), or refunds with interest if the buyer withdraws.
Units must be sold on carpet area; the promoter uploads quarterly progress updates and approvals on the RERA website.
Projects with built-up area of 20,000 sq m and above, and below 1,50,000 sq m, need prior EC from the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority (category B, item 8(a)).
regulations.condition: Built-up area includes basements and covered parking.

regulations.provision: Projects covering 50 ha or more, or built-up area of 1,50,000 sq m or more, fall under item 8(b) (area development) with fuller appraisal.
NBC 2016 treats buildings of 15 m and above as high-rise, triggering enhanced fire provisions and fire NOC. Several states use different thresholds (see city rows).
Access roads for fire tenders of at least 6 m clear width, a turning radius of about 9 m and clear head-room of at least 5 m, kept free of obstruction, with hard standing around the building.
regulations.condition: Exact values per Part 4 and state fire rules.

regulations.provision: Refuge areas are required at intervals in tall buildings (Part 4 sets the floor intervals and area per occupant).
Height clearance (NOC) from AAI is required within the colour-coded zoning maps around airports; apply on NOCAS with site coordinates.
No upper FAR limit for group housing on plots along roads of 45 m and wider, replacing the 3.5 ceiling. Height still governed by fire, AAI and other limits.
regulations.condition: Applies to eligible plots; implementation in developed sectors under committee review.
regulations.source: PropNewsTime, Noida adopts UP Model Building Regulations 2026

regulations.provision: Maximum FAR 3.5 (raised in Sept 2025) for group housing where the 2026 rules do not yet apply.
regulations.more_sources: PropNewsTime, Noida adopts UP Model Building Regulations 2026|https://propnewstime.com/latestnewsstories/MzkzMDA=/noida-authority-adopts-new-building-regulations-to-remove-far-ceiling-for-eligible-group-housing-projects

regulations.provision: Commercial FAR 1.5–4; industrial 2.5–3 (from 0.6–2); institutional 1.2–3, as revised in Sept 2025.
Ground coverage caps removed in Sept 2025; setbacks standardised at 3 m or 9 m depending on plot size.
1 to 1.5 car spaces per dwelling unit (earlier 1.25 ECS per 100 sq m of FAR area).
The 2026 model regulations apply to Greater Noida and YEIDA as well; a joint committee is settling implementation for already-developed sectors.
Maximum FAR depends on road width and is unrestricted on roads wider than 45 m (except near airports and protected monuments). On 12–24 m roads the base FAR is 1.5 and the maximum 3.0.
regulations.condition: Purchasable and premium FAR on payment.

regulations.provision: Group housing base FAR 2.0 in built-up areas and 3.0 in non-built-up areas where the special provisions of Chapter 4 apply.
FAR up to 5.25 in developed areas and 8.75 in undeveloped areas, as reported.
No fixed height limit; height follows from permitted FAR, except near airports and ASI-protected monuments.
regulations.more_sources: Daily Jagran, UP cabinet approves bye-laws 2025|https://www.thedailyjagran.com/uttar-pradesh/up-cabinet-approves-new-building-bye-laws-2025-implements-no-height-cap-e-approval-for-maps-key-highlights-10250037

regulations.provision: Uniform 5 m setback on all sides for group housing buildings up to 15 m high.
Group housing permitted on plots of 1,000 sq m in built-up areas; group housing layouts need an access road of at least 9 m.
FAR consumed by mandatory EWS/LIG units is not counted in overall FAR. EWS units 30–35 sq m carpet; LIG 35–45 sq m.
Residential up to 100 sq m and commercial up to 30 sq m need only registration; residential up to 500 sq m and commercial up to 200 sq m are auto-approved online on licensed architects' plans.
regulations.source: Daily Jagran, UP cabinet approves bye-laws 2025

regulations.provision: Professionals may use up to 25% of a home's FAR as an office, subject to parking.
FAR 175% (1.75) of site area for group housing; higher FAR available under TOD and purchasable-FAR policies.
Ground coverage about 35% for multi-storey group housing (33.33% in cooperative schemes).
No fixed height limit; structures above 30 m need airport (AAI) clearance.
Up to four basement levels, for parking and services only; basements used for parking or services are excluded from FAR.
Cantilevers, permitted projections, lift room, mumty, balconies, basements or floors used for parking/services, unenclosed stilts for parking are not counted in FAR.

75% coverage for plots up to 250 sq m and 66% above 250 sq m; maximum FAR up to 264–300% on payment. A further increase (to 75% up to 250 sq m and 66% up to 1,000 sq m) was proposed by DTCP in Oct 2026.

regulations.use: Commercial / mixed use in TOD zones
regulations.provision: Ground coverage in TOD zones aligned to 60% for commercial and mixed use (the Building Code limit); TOD FAR up to about 3.5 in intense zones.
FAR 200 for group housing, plus 15% of FAR for EWS and community-service housing over and above the permissible FAR and density.
regulations.condition: Within DDA layouts the layout plan governs.

regulations.provision: Front setback from 0 m (below 100 sq m) to 9–15 m (above 10,000 sq m) by plot size.

MPD-2021 remains the operative plan. DDA approved the successor (renamed Master Plan 2047) in Aug 2026 and sent it to MoHUA for notification; regeneration FAR of 260–340 had been proposed in the 2041 draft.

approvals.name: Title due diligence and land records
approvals.authority: Sub-registrar / revenue department; advocate's title opinion
approvals.why: Every later approval asks for proof of ownership or development rights. Defects found late can void approvals and RERA registration.
approvals.how: Commission a 30-year title search, encumbrance certificate and revenue-record check; resolve litigation and mutation before filing anything.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Land use confirmation / change of land use
approvals.why: The master plan must permit the intended use; otherwise a change of land use (CLU) or conversion is needed before any plan can be sanctioned.
approvals.how: Obtain a zoning or land-use certificate from the planning authority; if the use differs, apply for CLU or conversion with the prescribed fee.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Height clearance (AAI / defence NOC)
approvals.why: Within airport or airfield zones, permissible height is capped by aviation safety; plan sanction will not be issued for heights above the NOC.
approvals.how: Apply on NOCAS with WGS-84 site coordinates certified by a surveyor; defence airfields need a separate NOC from the station.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Heritage / monument NOC (where applicable)
approvals.authority: National Monuments Authority / local heritage committee
approvals.why: Sites within 300 m of protected monuments are regulated; construction in the regulated area needs permission.
approvals.how: Apply to the competent authority under the AMASR Act (NMA) or the local heritage committee.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Tree felling / transplantation permission
approvals.why: Removing trees without permission stops work and attracts penalties; compensatory plantation is usually required.
approvals.how: Survey trees, apply to the tree authority or forest department with a compensatory plantation plan.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Water, sewer and power availability letters
approvals.why: Environmental clearance and plan sanction both need confirmation that services can be supplied.
approvals.how: Apply to the water utility, sewerage board and electricity distribution company for availability or feasibility letters.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Fire NOC (provisional, at plan stage)
approvals.why: Buildings above the state's high-rise threshold, and most assembly or commercial buildings, cannot get plan sanction without fire approval of the design.
approvals.how: Submit fire-fighting design drawings (staircases, refuge areas, fire tender access, hydrants, sprinklers) to the state fire service.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Environmental clearance (SEIAA)
approvals.why: Required before construction starts for projects of 20,000 sq m built-up area and above; starting without it invites stop-work orders and penalties.
approvals.how: File Form-1/1A and conceptual plan on PARIVESH; the SEAC appraises and SEIAA grants EC with conditions.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Groundwater / dewatering NOC
approvals.why: Basement dewatering or borewell abstraction needs NOC from CGWA or the state groundwater authority.
approvals.how: Apply online with hydrogeological report and abstraction quantity.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Building plan sanction
approvals.authority: MCD / DDA / NDMC (Online Building Permit System)
approvals.why: The core permission: fixes FAR, height, setbacks and layout. RERA registration and construction depend on it.
approvals.how: Architect submits plans on the authority's online system; pay scrutiny fees, development charges and premiums; respond to queries.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Consent to Establish (pollution control board)
approvals.why: Mandatory before construction for projects requiring EC; covers construction-phase emissions and effluents.
approvals.how: Apply to the state pollution control board with EC copy and plans.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: RERA project registration
approvals.why: No advertisement, booking or sale is allowed before registration; violations attract penalties up to 10% of project cost.
approvals.how: Register on the state RERA portal with approvals, title, schedule and separate bank account details.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Commencement certificate / start intimation
approvals.authority: MCD / DDA / NDMC (Online Building Permit System)
approvals.why: Construction may begin only after the commencement certificate (or intimation where the law requires only that).
approvals.how: Apply after plan sanction with EC and CTE; some authorities issue CC in stages.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: BOCW registration and labour cess
approvals.why: Construction establishments must register and pay 1% labour cess; contractors need labour licences.
approvals.how: Register with the labour department; pay cess on construction cost.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Plinth / foundation inspection certificate
approvals.authority: MCD / DDA / NDMC (Online Building Permit System)
approvals.why: Many authorities inspect at plinth to confirm the building matches the sanctioned footprint before upper floors.
approvals.how: Notify the authority on completing the plinth; inspection certifies conformity.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Lift / escalator licence
approvals.why: Lifts must be registered and inspected by the state lift inspectorate before use.
approvals.how: Lift supplier and owner apply for erection permission and later for the operating licence after inspection.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Fire NOC (final)
approvals.why: Occupancy cannot be issued without final fire clearance confirming installed systems work.
approvals.how: Fire service inspects the completed building and tests systems.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Consent to Operate (pollution control board)
approvals.why: Needed before occupation where CTE was required; confirms STP and waste systems are operational.
approvals.how: Apply with completion evidence and STP commissioning reports.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Permanent water, sewer and power connections
approvals.why: Utilities release permanent connections on completion (often linked to occupancy).
approvals.how: Apply to each utility with completion documents; pay infrastructure charges.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Occupancy / completion certificate
approvals.authority: MCD / DDA / NDMC (Online Building Permit System)
approvals.why: Legal occupation, registration of conveyance and handover depend on the OC; RERA treats it as the completion milestone.
approvals.how: Apply with completion certificate from the architect and all NOCs; the authority inspects and issues OC.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: RERA completion, handover and conveyance
approvals.why: Promoter must hand over possession, form the association and execute conveyance; defect liability runs 5 years from possession.
approvals.how: Upload OC on RERA, offer possession, register conveyance deeds and hand over common areas.
approvals.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

approvals.name: Delhi Urban Art Commission clearance
approvals.why: Large public, commercial and group housing projects need DUAC's urban-design clearance before plan sanction.
approvals.how: Submit design drawings, models and site context through the building permit system for DUAC review.

approvals.authority: Tamil Nadu Fire and Rescue Services
approvals.why: Occupancy cannot be issued without final fire clearance confirming installed systems work.
approvals.how: Fire service inspects the completed building and tests systems.
approvals.notes: High-rise and special buildings get planning permission from CMDA and then a building permit from the local body; non-high-rise threshold is now 19.5 m.

approvals.name: Consent to Operate (pollution control board)
approvals.why: Needed before occupation where CTE was required; confirms STP and waste systems are operational.
approvals.how: Apply with completion evidence and STP commissioning reports.
approvals.notes: High-rise and special buildings get planning permission from CMDA and then a building permit from the local body; non-high-rise threshold is now 19.5 m.

approvals.name: Permanent water, sewer and power connections
approvals.why: Utilities release permanent connections on completion (often linked to occupancy).
approvals.how: Apply to each utility with completion documents; pay infrastructure charges.
approvals.notes: High-rise and special buildings get planning permission from CMDA and then a building permit from the local body; non-high-rise threshold is now 19.5 m.

approvals.name: Completion certificate (CMDA / GCC)
approvals.authority: CMDA planning permission, then GCC / local body building permit
approvals.why: Legal occupation, registration of conveyance and handover depend on the OC; RERA treats it as the completion milestone.
approvals.how: Apply with completion certificate from the architect and all NOCs; the authority inspects and issues OC.
approvals.notes: High-rise and special buildings get planning permission from CMDA and then a building permit from the local body; non-high-rise threshold is now 19.5 m.

approvals.name: RERA completion, handover and conveyance
approvals.why: Promoter must hand over possession, form the association and execute conveyance; defect liability runs 5 years from possession.
approvals.how: Upload OC on RERA, offer possession, register conveyance deeds and hand over common areas.
approvals.notes: High-rise and special buildings get planning permission from CMDA and then a building permit from the local body; non-high-rise threshold is now 19.5 m.

approvals.name: Title due diligence and land records
approvals.authority: Sub-registrar / revenue department; advocate's title opinion
approvals.why: Every later approval asks for proof of ownership or development rights. Defects found late can void approvals and RERA registration.
approvals.how: Commission a 30-year title search, encumbrance certificate and revenue-record check; resolve litigation and mutation before filing anything.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Land use confirmation / change of land use
approvals.why: The master plan must permit the intended use; otherwise a change of land use (CLU) or conversion is needed before any plan can be sanctioned.
approvals.how: Obtain a zoning or land-use certificate from the planning authority; if the use differs, apply for CLU or conversion with the prescribed fee.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Height clearance (AAI / defence NOC)
approvals.why: Within airport or airfield zones, permissible height is capped by aviation safety; plan sanction will not be issued for heights above the NOC.
approvals.how: Apply on NOCAS with WGS-84 site coordinates certified by a surveyor; defence airfields need a separate NOC from the station.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Heritage / monument NOC (where applicable)
approvals.authority: National Monuments Authority / local heritage committee
approvals.why: Sites within 300 m of protected monuments are regulated; construction in the regulated area needs permission.
approvals.how: Apply to the competent authority under the AMASR Act (NMA) or the local heritage committee.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Tree felling / transplantation permission
approvals.why: Removing trees without permission stops work and attracts penalties; compensatory plantation is usually required.
approvals.how: Survey trees, apply to the tree authority or forest department with a compensatory plantation plan.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Water, sewer and power availability letters
approvals.authority: KMC Water Supply / NKDA / CESC / WBSEDCL
approvals.why: Environmental clearance and plan sanction both need confirmation that services can be supplied.
approvals.how: Apply to the water utility, sewerage board and electricity distribution company for availability or feasibility letters.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Fire NOC (provisional, at plan stage)
approvals.authority: West Bengal Fire and Emergency Services
approvals.why: Buildings above the state's high-rise threshold, and most assembly or commercial buildings, cannot get plan sanction without fire approval of the design.
approvals.how: Submit fire-fighting design drawings (staircases, refuge areas, fire tender access, hydrants, sprinklers) to the state fire service.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Environmental clearance (SEIAA)
approvals.why: Required before construction starts for projects of 20,000 sq m built-up area and above; starting without it invites stop-work orders and penalties.
approvals.how: File Form-1/1A and conceptual plan on PARIVESH; the SEAC appraises and SEIAA grants EC with conditions.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Groundwater / dewatering NOC
approvals.why: Basement dewatering or borewell abstraction needs NOC from CGWA or the state groundwater authority.
approvals.how: Apply online with hydrogeological report and abstraction quantity.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Building plan sanction
approvals.authority: KMC building sanction (online) / NKDA for New Town
approvals.why: The core permission: fixes FAR, height, setbacks and layout. RERA registration and construction depend on it.
approvals.how: Architect submits plans on the authority's online system; pay scrutiny fees, development charges and premiums; respond to queries.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Consent to Establish (pollution control board)
approvals.why: Mandatory before construction for projects requiring EC; covers construction-phase emissions and effluents.
approvals.how: Apply to the state pollution control board with EC copy and plans.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: RERA project registration
approvals.why: No advertisement, booking or sale is allowed before registration; violations attract penalties up to 10% of project cost.
approvals.how: Register on the state RERA portal with approvals, title, schedule and separate bank account details.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Commencement certificate / start intimation
approvals.authority: KMC building sanction (online) / NKDA for New Town
approvals.why: Construction may begin only after the commencement certificate (or intimation where the law requires only that).
approvals.how: Apply after plan sanction with EC and CTE; some authorities issue CC in stages.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: BOCW registration and labour cess
approvals.why: Construction establishments must register and pay 1% labour cess; contractors need labour licences.
approvals.how: Register with the labour department; pay cess on construction cost.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Plinth / foundation inspection certificate
approvals.authority: KMC building sanction (online) / NKDA for New Town
approvals.why: Many authorities inspect at plinth to confirm the building matches the sanctioned footprint before upper floors.
approvals.how: Notify the authority on completing the plinth; inspection certifies conformity.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

approvals.name: Lift / escalator licence
approvals.why: Lifts must be registered and inspected by the state lift inspectorate before use.
approvals.how: Lift supplier and owner apply for erection permission and later for the operating licence after inspection.
approvals.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.

jurisdictions.name: Delhi (MCD / DDA / NDMC)
jurisdictions.notes: Delhi plan approvals sit with MCD (most areas), DDA (DDA layouts) or NDMC (Lutyens' area). Large projects need DUAC clearance.

jurisdictions.name: Noida (Noida Authority)
jurisdictions.notes: Noida is an industrial development area: land comes by allotment or auction from the Noida Authority on lease, so the lease deed replaces a CLU, and the Authority issues both plan approval and occupancy.

jurisdictions.name: Greater Noida (GNIDA) and YEIDA
jurisdictions.notes: Same leasehold model as Noida. Near Jewar (Noida International Airport), AAI height limits are critical.

jurisdictions.name: Ghaziabad (GDA)
jurisdictions.notes: Governed by the UP Development Authority Bye-laws 2025, with deemed and self-certified approvals for small buildings.

jurisdictions.name: Gurugram (DTCP / GMDA)
jurisdictions.notes: Group housing and commercial colonies need a DTCP licence under the Haryana Development and Regulation of Urban Areas Act 1975 before building plans; standalone plots need CLU.

jurisdictions.name: Faridabad (DTCP / FMDA)
jurisdictions.notes: Same Haryana licensing framework as Gurugram.

jurisdictions.name: Mumbai (MCGM)
jurisdictions.notes: MCGM issues an IOD (plan approval) first and then commencement certificates in stages up to full CC; coastal sites need CRZ clearance from MCZMA.

jurisdictions.name: Thane, Navi Mumbai, Panvel, KDMC and other MMR (UDCPR)
jurisdictions.notes: UDCPR 2020 governs; the planning authority may be the municipal corporation, CIDCO (Navi Mumbai nodes) or MMRDA (notified areas). Navi Mumbai airport influence zone (NAINA) has its own rules.

jurisdictions.name: Pune (PMC / PCMC / PMRDA)
jurisdictions.notes: UDCPR 2020 governs. Sites near Lohegaon air base and NDA need defence NOCs for height.

jurisdictions.name: Bengaluru (GBA / BDA / BMRDA)
jurisdictions.notes: Agricultural land needs conversion (DC conversion under the Karnataka Land Revenue Act) and khata before plan sanction; sites beyond GBA limits fall under BMRDA local planning authorities.

jurisdictions.name: Hyderabad (GHMC / HMDA)
jurisdictions.notes: Permissions are issued through TG-bPASS; agricultural land needs non-agricultural (NALA) conversion; 10% of built-up area is mortgaged to the authority until completion.

jurisdictions.name: Chennai (CMDA / GCC)
jurisdictions.notes: High-rise and special buildings get planning permission from CMDA and then a building permit from the local body; non-high-rise threshold is now 19.5 m.

jurisdictions.name: Kolkata (KMC / NKDA)
jurisdictions.notes: KMC sanctions plans under the KMC Building Rules 2009; New Town is sanctioned by NKDA under its own rules.
